note: Every Build 15 audit finding with the fields of spec §4. kind: defect (has a severity), review (no defect found), claim (external claim checked). Kept in step with audit.md by test_audit_findings.py.

findings.evidence: [section, section#0, section] produced section#0 twice with the original helper; 20,000 random lists after the fix
findings.root_cause: Generated suffixes did not reserve real keys shaped like generated ones
findings.user_impact: A list screen (home, search) can crash
alternatives: Reserve all original keys and skip taken suffixes
findings.rationale: Keeps every non-colliding key unchanged
findings.compatibility: Nuvio file: registered in features.json; small diff

findings.evidence: Scaling run: 60 KB malformed file 5.2 s, 1 MB minutes; 60,000-file old/new comparison equal on well-formed input
findings.root_cause: Rescanning the rest of the file from every position on unclosed tags (quadratic)
findings.user_impact: A malformed add-on subtitle freezes download preparation or the subtitle list
findings.rationale: Fixes the cause without changing well-formed output

findings.evidence: Code review: size cap, empty-file check, ASCII cache name, decoding on IO inside runCatching
findings.user_impact: None found
findings.rationale: No defect

findings.evidence: One copy per import in cache/device-subtitles, never removed (code review)
findings.root_cause: Copies were never cleaned
findings.user_impact: Cache grows with each import until Android clears it
alternatives: Remove earlier processes' copies on import
Leave to the OS cache trimming
findings.rationale: Device subtitles are never stored as preferences, so nothing references old copies

findings.evidence: Code review of executeToFolder (K-03)

findings.user_impact: A download can start without enough space and fail later; no data loss
alternatives: Re-read the document size before the check

findings.evidence: LocalSubtitleSyncCuesTest: local file and HTTP

findings.evidence: updateSubtitleGesture saved 12 settings about sixty times per second of dragging

findings.user_impact: Wrong parser for ASS/VTT files picked without a known extension; non-subtitles accepted

findings.evidence: Harness r1-r13: no lost update or duplicate enqueue
findings.root_cause: Claimed race not present: all writers run on Main
findings.user_impact: None found
findings.rationale: Risk unproven; harness added instead

findings.evidence: Policy test and race harness r11 fail on the old code: a paused episode held every later episode of the profile, and resuming it while the queue ran started a second download
findings.root_cause: SeasonQueuePolicy.busy counted Paused items as running (design since Build 13, reversed by the owner's decision of 2026-11-20)
findings.user_impact: Pausing one episode stopped the rest of the season and other seasons; resume could start a duplicate download
alternatives: Episode pause skips, season and 'pause all' hold (owner's contract)
Keep the Build 13 behaviour (one pause holds everything)
findings.chosen: Owner's contract: episode pause skips; season pause holds that season; 'pause all' holds every download of the current profile and new ones until 'resume all', which never resumes one paused on its own
findings.rationale: Owner decision D-01 and the download contract
findings.compatibility: Stored queue format readable by Builds 12-14 (SeasonQueueStorageTest); Nuvio files registered in features.json
tests_required: notification pause/resume on Android 14 and 9 emulators

findings.evidence: Release APK of Build 14: application usesCleartextTraffic=true and base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted=true (security-surface.py on the published x86_64 APK)
findings.root_cause: Upstream Nuvio allows plain http for all hosts
findings.user_impact: Traffic to http add-ons or servers can be read or changed on the network; https traffic is unaffected
alternatives: Keep (add-ons and self-hosted servers on the local network are often http)
Allow http only for local addresses (breaks remote http add-ons that work today)
findings.chosen: Keep, recorded as accepted risk; any change of the rule fails security-surface.py until reviewed
findings.rationale: Owner rule 10: no change of working features outside the scope without need; no evidence of a Plus-specific risk

findings.evidence: Ruleset 27721857 (read 2026-11-21) only blocks deletion and force push of custom-subtitles; no required pull request or status checks; plus-ci.yml states that branch protection requires nuvio-plus/checks
findings.root_cause: Required checks were never added to the ruleset
findings.user_impact: A merge or push with failing or pending checks is not stopped by GitHub (owner rule 5 depends on discipline)
alternatives: Require a pull request and the listed checks (proposal)
Keep relying on the merge discipline of each session
findings.chosen: Proposal for the owner (this session cannot change repository settings)
findings.rationale: Spec §12; owner rule 5
tests_required: Re-read the ruleset after the owner applies it

findings.evidence: Android lint TrustAllX509TrustManager (static-analysis run 44866405817) in composeApp; source: trustAllManager accepts every certificate and playbackHostnameVerifier every host name for the playback OkHttp client, which also adds the stream's Authorization header
findings.root_cause: Upstream Nuvio choice for stream hosts with broken or self-signed certificates
findings.user_impact: On a hostile network (public Wi-Fi) a stream request can be intercepted; an Authorization header sent with it (debrid or add-on token) can be read
alternatives: Verify certificates when the request carries an Authorization header; keep trust-all otherwise
Verify certificates always (may break IPTV sources with self-signed certificates)
findings.chosen: Owner decision (substantive behaviour change outside what was approved)
findings.rationale: Changes which streams play; owner rule on high-risk changes
tests_required: Unit test of the client's trust choice
playback of an https stream with a valid certificate on the emulator

findings.evidence: SubtitlePlaybackTest (libmpv) failed once on Android 14 with CalledFromWrongThreadException at line 1652; passed on the same app code before
findings.root_cause: Hypothesis: resume after withContext(mpvDispatcher) on a non-main thread (in the test scheduler or the app: not established)
findings.user_impact: Crash while playing with libmpv if it happens in the app
alternatives: Set the view property on Dispatchers.Main.immediate
findings.chosen: (a) Back on Dispatchers.Main.immediate before touching the view, in both effects that follow snapshot()
findings.rationale: In the app the effects already resume on the main thread, so Main.immediate does not dispatch and behaviour is unchanged; it removes the dependence on the dispatcher the effect runs under
tests_required: SubtitlePlaybackTest on Android 14 and 9 (passed once after the fix; repeated runs still to show the intermittent failure is gone)
